status: Canonical team specification for the completed 180-game comparison; battle fields preserved from the original freeze.
game: Original Pokémon Diamond, European Rev 5 engine
historical_name_note: Case name fields retain the original CynthiaBench labels used during the scored study; display_name uses the public PokéBench name.

construction_policy.source_types: Eight self-reported completion accounts and two human-authored team designs.
construction_policy.start: All six healthy, default species names, full base move PP, no PP Ups; order as listed.
construction_policy.shared_unknown_traits: Hardy nature, IV 15 and EV 48 in each stat, friendship 200 before battle initialization. The game naturally increments friendship during initialization.
construction_policy.missing_ability: First original-Diamond species ability slot unless a source establishes an ability.
construction_policy.gender: Source value when established; otherwise deterministic assignment using the species gender ratio.
construction_policy.acquisition: Trades, breeding, delayed evolution, TMs/HMs and Pearl exclusives are permitted construction routes; this is not a claim of solo acquisition in one untouched Diamond playthrough.
